newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended weaker across the board on Thursday, pressured by private investors' profit-taking, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 1.1 yen per kg lower. Benchmark March was 0.2 yen weaker at 137.2 yen.

"Profit-taking sales emerged after sharp gains on Wednesday due to unexpected falls in Japan's rubber stocks," a trader said. Market sentiment was mixed as private investors were divided as to whether Japan's rubber stocks had reached their ceiling or not, the traders said.
